doc: Design §11 row 5: the hub's never-set wins over any grant. An Emacs server's port (in the never-set before the job) is refused before any card (it is never offered, so no grant can open it); a port granted while free, which reaches its fixture, is refused at a later dial once an Emacs server file names it (the never-set is read every 30 s). The gateway's own port is the same set (gleipnir's `a_never_port_is_refused_under_any_grant`). On a Mac the checklist adds the machine's SSH and hypervisor REST ports (B4). The session's Network cell must allow a network (the autonomous preset). Needs rootless podman 5+, the relay binary `drgnx-px-<arch>-linux-musl` next to the hub binary, and a host lane; fixtures are busybox httpd on the host's loopback (host network). Unverified until the combined pass (CI rootless Ubuntu; the Fedora 45 VM gate with `ausearch -m avc` empty).

args: set -e; podman pull -q --policy=missing docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work $ROOT/www; echo fixture-ok > $ROOT/www/index.html; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-matrix (:preset "autonomous")) (drgnx-agents-profiles (("mock-claude" :provider claude :command ("$MOCK" "acp" "--as" "claude" "--log" "$ROOT/acp.log")))) (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el; cd $ROOT/work && export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' && git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m init

set -e; podman rm -f cn-host-pl >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; podman run -d --rm --network=host --name cn-host-pl -v $ROOT/www:/www:ro,z docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 httpd -f -p 127.0.0.1:18094 -h /www >/dev/null

argv:
hp() { { printf 'CONNECT host.drgnx.internal:%s HTTP/1.1
Host: host.drgnx.internal:%s

' $1 $1; sleep 1; printf 'GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close

'; sleep 2; } | nc -w 5 127.0.0.1 3128; }; code() { printf 'CONNECT %s HTTP/1.1
Host: %s

' $1 $1 | nc -w 3 127.0.0.1 3128 | head -1; }; i=0; while [ $i -lt 120 ]; do echo "pe $(code host.drgnx.internal:18093)"; echo "pl $(code host.drgnx.internal:18094)"; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done

args: L=$STATE/hub/exec/$job/log; awk '/^pl HTTP\/1.1 200/ {s=1} s && /^pl HTTP\/1.1 403/ {f=1} END {exit !f}' $L
test -z "$(podman ps -a -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$job)"; podman rm -f cn-host-pl >/dev/null 2>&1; true
